svg.title: Cortical syndromes, split by hemisphere and lobe: in the DOMINANT hemisphere, comprehension then fluency and repetition name the aphasia and its lobe (Broca's inferior frontal, Wernicke's posterior temporal, global full MCA territory; conduction and transcortical aphasias for keeners); the NON-DOMINANT hemisphere gives neglect; apraxia (parietal or frontal), cortical sensory loss (parietal) and extinction (touch parietal, vision occipital) are other cortical signs; a last column tells a subcortical or brainstem lesion apart
